instruction: Generate a web extension scaffold named "color-picker v1.0.5" with the webext.eu helper. Set description to "Pick colors from any page". Activate content scripts and options page only - skip background script and browser action. Save to "~/Projects".

metadata.explanation: This variation creates a color-picker extension with version 1.0.5, custom description, and includes only content_scripts and options_ui (without background script or browser_action). The evaluator checks the manifest.json for these specific properties. Uses existing check_json metric.

llm_judge_reasons: Incomplete coverage: Instruction explicitly requires 'skip background script and browser action', but evaluator only checks for presence of content_scripts and options_ui
Missing negative verification: Evaluator does not verify ABSENCE of 'background' and 'browser_action' fields in manifest.json
False positive risk: An extension with all features (including background and browser_action) would incorrectly pass evaluation
Partial verification: Only 5 out of 7 instruction requirements are verified (missing verification for 2 'skip' requirements)
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Add 'unexpect' rules to verify that 'background' and 'browser_action' keys do not exist in the manifest.json
Example fix: Add to rules.unexpect: [{"key": ["background"], "method": "not_exist", "ref": null}, {"key": ["browser_action"], "method": "not_exist", "ref": null}]
The check_json metric already supports 'unexpect' rules (see lines 362-377 in general.py), so this fix is straightforward

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_json first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
